Thanks for reading it.  Glad you like it.


Nancy🇺🇸🟦 (@revwiseman)

@BretBaier
Received your new book yesterday and started reading it.  I’m just an ordinary citizen, but it’s a great read. I like to learn about our history and am enjoying your book. Think I’ll be buying some more of your books!  Thanks for helping us to learn more about our history and what makes us proud to be Americans, despite our issues!



— https://nitter.net/revwiseman/status/2052070910920724636#m

Thank you all for sending in your cases for America this week! Please continue to do so on my website, thecaseforamerica.com, where you can also order my book. I'll be signing books at @Raptis Rare Books this Friday and Vero Beach Book Center this Saturday. Next week, I'm heading to Beijing with the President and bringing #specialreport on the road with us! #caseforamerica #book

BREAKING: The U.S. carried out targeted strikes on a key Iranian port today in response to attacks on Navy vessels, though officials emphasize that the current cease-fire remains in place. @JACQUI reports live.  #breaking #news #iran
U.S. Ambassador Mike Waltz call on the United Nations to condemn Iran’s “illegal” attempts to regulate and mine the Strait of Hormuz. #specialreport #iran #unitednations
I wrote The Case for America for my kids. I think it’s important for the next generation to fight for this country, we’re passing the baton to them #caseforamerica #freedom #genz #america250
Who’s taking the podium next? Martha MacCallum and @Bill Hemmer weigh in their thoughts on who will rise to the top in the coming 2028 elections, Vance or Rubio? #specialreport #vance #marcorubio

Hey Florida! I'm excited to announce that I'll be at Vero Beach Book Center for a book signing this Saturday. Come on by to get your books signed – I’d love to meet you there!  #caseforamerica #booksigning #florida #verobeach #author

I personally recorded the audiobook for #caseforamerica! Check it out today and visit thecaseforamerica.com to learn how you can win a free signed copy of the book! 🎧📚 #AudiobookNarration #BookGiveaway
Wow…what can I say, you really never know what you’re going to get from @The Five. Thanks @Dana Perino, @Jesse Watters, @Gutfeld! #foxnews #song #weirdtok
My new book officially comes out today! A huge thank you to everyone who sent in their cases for America. Make sure to order your copy today! #caseforamerica #book #america250
Thank you @Bill Hemmer for joining my panel tonight and sharing your thoughts on the war in Iran #panel #specialreport
